mod.description: Finished items go straight into a chest next to the workbench or station.
Enabled.name: Mod enabled
Enabled.description: Turns the mod on or off (takes effect immediately).
ZombieWorkbenches.name: Zombie workbenches
ZombieWorkbenches.description: Items finished by zombie workers go straight into a chest next to the workbench instead of waiting for you to pick them up, so the zombie keeps working right away.
ZombieWorkbenches.hint: Zombie output goes into a nearby chest, the zombie keeps working.
ZombieIngredients.name: Zombie ingredients from chests
ZombieIngredients.description: Zombie workers take the ingredients they need straight from the storages within the search radius, so no other zombie has to bring them. Ingredients another zombie is already bringing are left to it. If there is not enough nearby, the zombie waits as usual.
ZombieIngredients.hint: Zombie workers take their ingredients from nearby storages, no other zombie has to bring them.
AutoCrafters.name: Auto-crafting stations
AutoCrafters.description: Stations that craft on their own (e.g. ovens) put their finished items into a chest next to them instead of waiting for you to collect them, and keep running.
AutoCrafters.hint: E.g. ovens: finished items go into a nearby chest, the station keeps running.
CollectResearchPoints.name: Collect research points
CollectResearchPoints.description: Research points (the orbs) from stations the mod collects for you fly straight to you, like when you sleep, wherever you are. Off = they drop on the ground next to the station.
CollectResearchPoints.hint: Research points from these stations fly straight to you instead of dropping.
EmptyWells.name: Empty wells into chests
EmptyWells.description: Upgraded wells fill up with water and stop when they are full. The water is moved into a chest within the search radius every few seconds, so the well keeps producing.
EmptyWells.hint: Water from upgraded wells goes into a nearby chest, so the well never stops.
HarvestBeehives.name: Harvest beehives
HarvestBeehives.description: Full beehives are harvested automatically, as if you did it yourself: the honey and beeswax go into a chest within the search radius, and the hive starts filling up again. Wild honey nests are left alone.
HarvestBeehives.hint: Full beehives are harvested into a nearby chest and start filling up again.
AutoRefuel.name: Refuel from chests
AutoRefuel.description: When a station waits for fuel and a fuel storage in the same area can make that fuel from materials in your chests, the fuel storage is refilled automatically (only as much as the station needs).
AutoRefuel.hint: Fuel storages make the fuel a waiting station needs from materials in your chests.
RepeatRecipes.name: Repeat recipes (999x)
RepeatRecipes.description: When you add a recipe with count 1 to the queue of an oven or a zombie workbench, it is set to 999 so the station keeps producing. Pick a different count in the craft window to keep it, or lower it with "-" in the queue (hold to count fast).
RepeatRecipes.hint: Recipes queued with count 1 at ovens and zombie workbenches become 999.
AutoRecipes.name: Pick recipes from nearby chests
AutoRecipes.description: Stardew style: an idle oven (or other station that works on its own) looks into the chests within the search radius and crafts one of its recipes once, if all its ingredients are there (fuel may come from the fuel storage). Then it checks again, so it keeps running and switches between recipes: first recipes no other station in the area is making right now, then the one whose result you have the least of. It takes the ingredients from the nearby chests first.
AutoRecipes.hint: Idle ovens craft from the ingredients in a nearby chest, one at a time, what you lack most.
ZombieAutoRecipes.name: Pick recipes for zombie workbenches
ZombieAutoRecipes.description: Like "Pick recipes from nearby chests", but for workbenches with a zombie worker: when the zombie has nothing to do, it picks a recipe it can make (tool and mastery) whose ingredients are all in the storages within the search radius, crafts it once and then picks again. Recipes no other station in the area is making come first, then the one whose result you have the least of. Works best together with "Zombie ingredients from chests".
ZombieAutoRecipes.hint: Idle zombie workbenches pick a recipe from the ingredients in nearby chests, one at a time.
StationSpeed.name: Station speed
StationSpeed.description: How fast stations that craft on their own work, such as ovens and distillers (1.0 = normal, up to 10x). Garden beds, town building construction and stations with a zombie worker are not affected, and neither are tables you work at yourself (workbenches, autopsy and embalming table). For those, see Tireless Keeper.
StationSpeed.hint: How fast ovens, distillers and the like work (1.0 = normal). Not for tables you work at yourself.
ChestRadius.name: Chest search radius
ChestRadius.description: How far a chest may be from the station (center to center, roughly 1 per tile). 0 = any chest in the same area. Chests that already hold the item are preferred.
ChestRadius.hint: Max. distance to the chest (about 1 per tile). 0 = whole area.
DropIfNoChest.name: Drop on the ground if no chest
DropIfNoChest.description: If there is no chest with room within the search radius, finished items drop on the ground next to the station instead, so ovens and zombies keep working. Off = they wait for you as usual.
DropIfNoChest.hint: No chest with room nearby: items drop next to the station, it keeps working.
station.description: Automate "{0}". Off = Graveyard Automation leaves this kind of station alone: no delivery into chests, no ingredients from chests, no refuelling, no picked or repeated recipes and no extra speed.
station.hint: Off = the mod leaves this kind of station alone.
